name: Parqueadero USTA - Design System
framework_look: Bootstrap 5 components (cards, tables, badges, alerts, navbar, forms) polished with a modern, premium finish

shape.shadow: soft, large blur, very low opacity (0 8px 24px rgba(31,42,68,0.08))

layout.canvas: desktop 1440x900 viewport, content max-width 1200px centered, 12-column grid, 24px gutters

navbar.style: solid navy bar, white text, gold underline on the active item
navbar.brand: round gold badge with a white letter P plus the text 'Parqueadero USTA' (generic placeholder logo, NOT a real university logo)

footer.style: light grey bar, small muted text
footer.text: Universidad Santo Tomás - Seccional Tunja · Desarrollo Orientado a Servicios 2026-2

shared_components.alerts: rounded, with a leading icon; success = green, error = red, warning = amber
shared_components.icons: simple line icons (Bootstrap Icons / Lucide style), 1.75px stroke

output.presentation: flat, front-on UI screenshot inside a minimal browser window frame, readable Spanish text
